title: Lula Defeats Bolsonaro for Brazil Presidency, in Blow to Latin America’s Right
summary_full: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva triumphed over Flávio Bolsonaro, the eldest son of the right-wing leader he defeated four years ago.
